### 1 — Scene
The central dish appears to be a chicken salad with leafy greens, shredded vegetables and dressing. I’m excluding the sandwich, soup, sushi and toast on the surrounding dishes.

### 2 — Vessel
A shallow plate, approximately **24 cm diameter**. Estimated area: 3.14 × 12² = **452 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: cooked chicken pieces, lettuce/cabbage leaves, shredded carrot and other cut vegetables, red pepper strips, and a light-colored dressing. The exact dressing is uncertain.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Area shares represent each component’s approximate allocation within the overlapping salad.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Leafy greens | 25% | 113 cm² × 2.5 cm = 283 ml | 0.15 | 42 g | 20 | 8 kcal |
| Cooked chicken | 20% | 90 cm² × 1.1 cm = 99 ml | 0.95 | 94 g | 165 | 155 kcal |
| Mixed cut vegetables | 20% | 90 cm² × 1.3 cm = 117 ml | 0.60 | 70 g | 30 | 21 kcal |
| Dressing | 5% | 23 cm² × 0.8 cm = 18 ml | 1.0 | 18 g | 250 | 45 kcal |

Total allocated coverage: **70%**, consistent with the salad leaving a visible rim.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **224 g and 229 kcal** is plausible for this moderately sized, loosely piled chicken salad. Dressing composition is the largest energy uncertainty.
